stats.label: Launched
stats.condition: First eligible ordinary desktop observation in an instrumented launch.

stats.label: Live organism observed
stats.condition: A healthy player colony is observed, including a loaded experiment.

stats.label: Returned in another launch
stats.condition: Another application launch observes an account that previously had a healthy colony. Not calendar-day retention.

stats.label: Successful feeding
stats.condition: Healthy player tissue is feeding with average base energy at least 50%.

stats.label: Reached 2 cells
stats.condition: At least 2 healthy player cells across the subject's colonies are observed.

stats.label: Reached 8 cells
stats.condition: At least 8 healthy player cells across the subject's colonies are observed.

stats.label: Reached 32 cells
stats.condition: At least 32 healthy player cells across the subject's colonies are observed.

stats.label: Subject lived 5 biological minutes
stats.condition: An observed healthy subject has accumulated at least 300 biological seconds. Includes restored lifespan; affected by simulation speed.

stats.label: Research started
stats.condition: Active research is observed while a healthy subject exists; includes restored active research.

stats.label: Research completed
stats.condition: At least one completed adaptation is observed, including restored progress.

stats.label: Research plan used
stats.condition: A non-paused research plan is observed for a healthy subject.

stats.label: Battery developed
stats.condition: A healthy player battery cell is observed.

stats.label: Collector developed
stats.condition: A healthy player collector cell is observed.

stats.label: Repair developed
stats.condition: A healthy player repair cell is observed.

stats.label: Muscle developed
stats.condition: A healthy player muscle cell is observed.

stats.label: Microscope discovered
stats.condition: A visible, unminimized microscope is observed during a healthy experiment.

stats.label: Cell details inspected
stats.condition: A visible, unminimized cell details window is observed during a healthy experiment.

stats.label: Application habitat used
stats.condition: A healthy experiment is bound to an application, including a restored habitat.

stats.label: Organism pulled
stats.condition: A healthy experiment has an active physical drag; no pointer positions are recorded.

stats.label: Photo mode used
stats.condition: Active photo mode is observed during a healthy experiment, including restored mode.

stats.label: Recovered from danger
stats.condition: The same subject recovers from average base energy below 20% to at least 50% while feeding, or has the Survivor milestone.

stats.label: Ran for 2 real minutes
stats.condition: Cumulative unpaused healthy desktop runtime reaches 120 real seconds, independent of focus or simulation speed.

stats.label: Ran for 5 real minutes
stats.condition: Cumulative unpaused healthy desktop runtime reaches 300 real seconds.

stats.label: Ran for 10 real minutes
stats.condition: Cumulative unpaused healthy desktop runtime reaches 600 real seconds.

stats.label: Experienced extinction
stats.condition: An observed healthy subject becomes extinct in this launch; restored extinction alone does not qualify.

stats.label: Instrumented launches
stats.condition: One per eligible application process. Sum of launches, not unique accounts.

stats.label: Healthy runtime
stats.condition: Cumulative real seconds with healthy player cells and unpaused ordinary desktop simulation. Excludes closed/suspended, lab, Debug and diagnostic time.

stats.label: Runtime with menu visible
stats.condition: Healthy runtime while the main menu or research window is visible and unminimized. Does not establish attention.

stats.label: Runtime with menu hidden
stats.condition: Healthy runtime with both menu and research window hidden or minimized; microscope visibility does not change this bucket.

stats.label: Best healthy cell count
stats.condition: Account's highest observed healthy cell count across subjects. Global sum of account maxima, not largest colony worldwide.

stats.label: Best completed research count
stats.condition: Account's highest observed completed adaptation count in one experiment. Max 6 in demo, 18 in full. Global sum of maxima.

stats.label: Demo: survival goal
stats.condition: Demo survival checklist goal observed as complete.

stats.label: Demo: growth goal
stats.condition: Demo 8-cell checklist goal observed as complete.

stats.label: Demo: research goal
stats.condition: Demo research checklist goal observed as complete.

stats.label: Demo: specialization goal
stats.condition: Demo specialized-cell checklist goal observed as complete.

stats.label: Demo: recovery goal
stats.condition: Demo recovery checklist goal observed as complete.

stats.label: Demo: all required goals completed
stats.condition: Survival, growth, research, sequencing and inherited gene effect goals observed as complete, including restored checklist progress. Specialization and recovery are optional. Historical totals retain earlier builds' completion criteria.

stats.label: Demo: completion summary shown
stats.condition: Completion summary is acknowledged by the existing UI/host action; a restored summarySeen field alone is insufficient.

stats.label: Demo: full-game link opened
stats.condition: ShellExecute accepts the full-game store-link action. Does not measure page loads, wishlists or purchases.

stats.label: First gene sequenced
stats.condition: At least one allowed sequenced gene is observed in the persistent lab, including restored progress and sequencing without live tissue.

stats.label: First gene inherited
stats.condition: A healthy subject expresses at least one allowed gene in its fixed birth template, including a loaded experiment. Selection alone does not count.

stats.label: Inherited gene effect observed
stats.condition: An expressed allowed gene produces finite positive measured work during an eligible live biology step. Loading or equipping a gene alone does not count.

stats.label: Best sequenced gene count
stats.condition: Account's highest observed allowed sequenced library count. Max 4 in demo, 20 in full. Global sum of account maxima, not an average or worldwide maximum.

stats.label: Best expressed gene count
stats.condition: Account's highest observed expressed gene count in a healthy subject. Max 3 in demo, 10 in full. Global sum of account maxima, not an average or worldwide maximum.

stats.label: Demo: sequencing goal
stats.condition: Required demo sequencing checklist goal observed as complete, including restored checklist progress.

stats.label: Demo: inherited gene effect goal
stats.condition: Required demo inherited gene effect checklist goal observed as complete, including restored checklist progress. Shared DNA effect tracking requires a new live effect.
